summary_en: Phosphorus is a chemical element with symbol P and atomic number 15. As an element, phosphorus exists in two major forms—white phosphorus and red phosphorus—but due to its high reactivity, phosphorus is never found as a free element on Earth. Instead phosphorus-containing minerals are almost always present in their maximally oxidised state, as inorganic phosphate rocks.
summary_ko: Phosphorus은(는) 다원자 비금속 원소로, 비료 등에 쓰이는 기본 소재다. 상온에서는 이며 안전 지침을 따라 다루는 것이 권장된다.
